Name: (CP) Pet Gift Chance Adjuster
Author: JustinMercer123
Description:
[b][CP] Pet Gift Chance Adjuster[/b]

Content Patcher mod
Lets you adjust the chance that a pet with maximum friendship will give you a gift when you pet it.
The base game chance is 20%.  This lets you change that chance anywhere between 0% and 100%.

[b]Motivation: [/b]
1) In late-game I find the pet gifts to be more annoying than useful. I still want to pet my cat without having to deal with the unwanted gifts.
2) Learn simple modding with Content Patcher

This only works with base game pets (Cat, Dog, Turtle)
There are no confirmed conflicts, but this mod will probably conflict with other mods that change the pet gift chance or pet gift quality
This mod has only been tested on PC

[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
This mod is compatible with multi-player on PC (has not been tested in split-screen mode)
Only players who want to change the settings need to have this mod installed.
Changes to the config settings only affect the player who made the changes.  

[b]Translations: [/b]
i18n compatible
The only text is in the config menu
Currently available in English and Spanish (My Spanish language skills are really bad.  Sorry.)
You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.
You can publish the translation file yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
[b]
Requirements:[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6.9 or later (The pet gift data format was changed in 1.6.9 - This mod expects the new format)

[b]Required Mods:[/b]
SMAPI
Content Patcher

[b]Not required but strongly recommended:[/b]
GMCM - Generic Mod Config Menu

[b]Installation:[/b]
Have Stardew valley 1.6.9 or later
    Install the latest version of SMAPI
    Install the latest version of Content Patcher
    Install the latest version of GMCM - Generic Mod Config Menu
    Download and unzip this mod.
    Place the folder [CP]PetGiftChanceAdjuster inside your Mods folder, located in your Stardew Valley installation directory.
        On Windows: usually C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
        On Mac: ~\Library\Application Support\StardewValley\Mods
        On Linux: ~/.local/share/StardewValley/Mods
    Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI.

The first time Stardew Vally is run with this mod installed, a config.json file will be created in this mod's folder
Either edit the config.json file directly or use GMCM in-game to change the settings
The mod is turned off by default
You will need to change the GiftChanceOverrideEnabled setting to "true" in config.json (or click on the "Enabled" checkbox in the GMCM menu) to activate it
The default Gift Chance settings (0.2) match the unmodified base game, so you should not see any difference until you change them
Changes to the settings take effect at the beginning of the first in-game day after the change is made

Acceptable decimal values range from 0.0 to 1.0
CatGiftPercent: 0.0=never, 1.0=always, 0.2=normal
DogGiftPercent: 0.0=never, 1.0=always, 0.2=normal
TurtleGiftPercent: 0.0=never, 1.0=always, 0.2=normal

[b]GiftQualityBonusEnabled:[/b]
When this is turned on, some of the pet gifts might have a higher quality

[spoiler]
Player must have obtained the Special Charm from Secret Note 20
The goal is to provide higher-quality versions of some of the regular gifts - but only in qualities that could be obtained with other methods in the base game
If the possible gifts in a gift group have different maximum qualities available in the base game, then the quality of all gifts in that group will be enhanced only to the lowest available maximum in that group.

Examples:
Cat gifts
River fish and Mountain fish are not enhanced.  The way the game selects these fish, green algae and river jelly are also possible.
These can only be obtained as normal quality in the base game, and I cannot easily separate them from actual fish.  So all gifts from these gift groups remain at normal quality.

Dog Gifts
All possible dog gift items are only available in normal quality in the base game, so none are enhanced

Turtle gifts
The Turtle "seafood" gift group includes lobster and mussel.  While mussels can be iridium quality, the maximum quality of lobster in the base game is silver, so this gift group is set to silver.
Seafoam Pudding is available in a max of gold quality (using Qi Seasoning) in the base game, so this gift item is enhanced only to gold quality
[/spoiler]

[b]Source code:[/b]
This is a Content Patcher mod - The files you get [i]are[/i] the source code.
